subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Kraljic Matrix
description: Learn The Kraljic Matrix in one minute.

hook.text: You manage pencils and jet engines the same way? That's a problem. Not all purchases deserve equal attention.

buildup.text: The Kraljic Matrix classifies purchases on two axes: profit impact and supply risk.

discovery.text: It creates four quadrants: routine, leverage, bottleneck, and strategic—each needing a different approach.

twist.text: Companies often spend more time negotiating commodity items than managing critical, risky suppliers.

climax.text: Strategic items get partnerships. Leverage items get competition. Bottlenecks get risk plans. Routine gets automation.

punchline.text: Treat each purchase based on what it's worth and what could go wrong.

quiz.question: What are the two axes of the Kraljic Matrix?
